name: Classic Latte
steps: Warm your cup with hot water, then discard
Brew your capsule directly into a large latte glass or cup
Steam 150ml of whole milk until velvety and microfoam forms
Pour steamed milk over the espresso in a steady stream
Add a small dollop of foam on top to finish
Serve immediately and enjoy

name: Cappuccino
steps: Brew your espresso capsule into a cappuccino cup
Steam 100ml of cold whole milk until it doubles in volume with thick foam
Pour one-third steamed milk over the espresso
Spoon thick milk foam on top to fill the cup
Dust with cocoa powder if desired
Serve immediately while hot

name: Flat White
steps: Brew your capsule as a ristretto (25ml) into a small ceramic cup
Steam 100ml of cold whole milk to silky microfoam consistency — less foam than cappuccino
Pour milk over espresso with a gentle swirling motion
The result should be a thin layer of microfoam on top
Serve immediately — the flat white is all about ratio and texture

name: Macchiato
steps: Brew your espresso capsule into a small espresso cup
Gently steam or froth 20ml of cold milk
Spoon or pour a small dollop of foam on top of the espresso
The espresso should be 'stained' with milk — that's a macchiato
Serve immediately

name: Cortado
steps: Brew your capsule as an espresso into a small glass
Warm 30ml of milk to just below boiling (do not foam)
Pour the warm milk over the espresso in equal ratio
The goal is to cut (cortar) the espresso's acidity with warm milk
Serve in a small glass without foam

name: Iced Coffee
steps: Fill a tall glass with ice cubes
Brew your espresso capsule directly over the ice
The hot espresso will chill instantly as it hits the ice
Add cold water or cold milk to taste
Stir gently and add sweetener if desired
Serve immediately with a straw

name: Iced Latte
steps: Brew your espresso capsule into a small cup and let it cool slightly
Fill a tall glass with ice cubes
Pour cold milk over the ice
Gently pour the cooled espresso over the milk
Stir gently — enjoy the swirling layers before mixing
Add simple syrup if you prefer sweetness, stir, and serve

name: Affogato
ingredients: 1-2 scoops vanilla gelato or ice cream
steps: Place 1-2 scoops of premium vanilla gelato in a chilled glass or bowl
Brew your espresso capsule into a separate small cup
Pour the hot espresso directly over the cold gelato
The gelato begins to melt into the espresso — serve immediately
Eat and drink together — the contrast of hot and cold is the magic
Optional: add a biscotti on the side

name: Espresso Tonic
steps: Fill a tall glass with ice cubes
Pour chilled premium tonic water over the ice — fill halfway
Brew your espresso capsule into a separate cup and let cool 1 minute
Slowly pour the espresso over the tonic — pour over the back of a spoon for layering
Do not stir — enjoy the layered effect
Garnish with a lemon or lime slice if desired

name: Vienna Coffee
steps: Brew your capsule as a lungo (110ml) into a Vienna coffee glass or tall cup
Top the coffee with a generous dollop of lightly whipped cream
Do not stir — let the cream float on top
Dust with cocoa powder or cinnamon
Sip the coffee through the cream for the authentic Vienna experience
Serve with a small chocolate or biscotti on the side

name: Café au Lait
steps: Heat 200ml of whole milk in a saucepan or microwave until steaming — do not boil
Brew your lungo capsule into a large, pre-warmed bowl or wide cup
Pour the hot milk and coffee simultaneously into the cup
The equal ratio creates the classic café au lait balance
No foam — this is not a latte. Simple, warm, and satisfying
Serve without stirring for best presentation

name: Ristretto Macchiato
steps: Brew your capsule as a ristretto (25ml) into a tiny espresso cup
Froth just 15ml of cold milk into a light foam
Top the ristretto with a single teaspoon of milk foam
The foam barely marks the top — hence 'macchiato' (marked)
Serve immediately and drink in one or two sips for the full experience

name: Lungo Black
steps: Use a lungo-compatible Nespresso capsule
Place a prewarmed mug under the machine
Select the lungo setting (110ml) on your Nespresso machine
Brew the full lungo volume — the water extracts through slowly for a different character
The lungo is not just a long espresso — it has its own distinct flavor
Serve black or with a drop of cold water to open up the flavors

name: Cold Brew Style
steps: Brew both capsules as a double lungo into a container
Allow the coffee to cool to room temperature (10-15 minutes)
Transfer to the refrigerator and chill until very cold (or add to ice)
When chilled, pour over a glass filled with ice
Add cold water to dilute to your preferred strength
Sweeten with simple syrup if desired — cold brew needs more sweetener than hot coffee
Stir gently and serve immediately

name: Vanilla Latte
steps: Add vanilla syrup to the bottom of a large cup or glass
Brew your espresso capsule directly into the cup with the syrup
Stir lightly to combine espresso and vanilla
Steam or froth 150ml of cold whole milk to velvety microfoam
Pour steamed milk over the espresso mixture
Top with a small amount of foam and serve immediately
Optional: add a pinch of vanilla powder on top
